findings.evidence: `Componentwise.lean:106` defines `zigzagAlgebra` as the public algebra, while the roadmap at lines 271–275 requires packaging self-injectivity and explicitly includes rank-one and disconnected cases; grep finds only `moduleInjective_nonisolatedZigzagQuotient` and `moduleInjective_zigzagProjective` in this PR.
findings.fix: Expose `Module.Injective (zigzagAlgebra k G) (zigzagAlgebra k G)` for arbitrary finite `G`, proving the dual-number singleton factors and finite product assembly, with the quotient theorem as the nonisolated component case.
findings.issue: Self-injectivity is exposed only for `nonisolatedZigzagQuotient`, not the canonical componentwise `zigzagAlgebra`; consumers cannot obtain the promised result for disconnected graphs or isolated vertices.

summary: The self-injectivity API does not cover the canonical public zigzag algebra, leaving the roadmap product under-exposed.
